::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 21 [1894?]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e.174 ff 171-2
:::

Dear [Mr Bullock](people/person_221.qmd),
The word in the French version is <u>vertu</u>. I have made it power, as that must be the sense[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: This message evidently relates to the work CMY did for Bullock's *Daily Lections*.
